# Spec: App Launcher

> Contract for the app launcher (and clipboard search mode). Functional tests
> verify the **Functional** section; the compliance linter + visual checklist
> verify the **Visual** section.

## Overview

- **Source**: `src/widget/applauncher/` (entry: `index.tsx`; items:
  `appButton.tsx`, `clipboardButton.tsx`)
- **Settings group**: reads `bar.position` only (for window anchoring)
- **State**: `ShellState.launcherOpen` / `ShellState.launcherQuery`;
  window registered via `WindowManager.setApplauncher`
- **Layer/behavior**: single `Astal.Window`, anchored
  TOP|BOTTOM|LEFT-or-RIGHT (side follows `bar.position`), `margin: 12`,
  `Keymode.ON_DEMAND`, shown on the focused Hyprland monitor
  (`hyprland.focusedMonitor`)

## Functional

### States

| # | State | Trigger | Expected behavior |
|---|-------|---------|-------------------|
| F1 | Open | `ShellState.launcherOpen` true | Window becomes visible; entry grabs focus; if `launcherQuery` is set the entry text is pre-filled and search runs with it |
| F2 | Close | visibility → false | Entry text cleared, mode reset to `apps`, `ShellState.launcherQuery` reset to `''` |
| F3 | Apps mode (empty query) | entry text empty | List = all apps ranked by frecency (`FrecencyManager.rankByFrecency`) |
| F4 | Apps mode (query) | text not starting with `>` | Fuzzy search (`fuzzyQuery`), results re-ranked by `FrecencyManager.getSearchBoost` score descending |
| F5 | Clipboard mode | text starts with `>` | Mode switches to `clipboard`; `searchClipboard(query.slice(1))` populates list asynchronously; placeholder text and hint label change |
| F6 | Vertical bar conflict | window becomes visible while `bar.position` is LEFT/RIGHT and QuickSettings is open | QuickSettings is closed (`qsOpen = false`) |
| F7 | Empty results | list length 0 | `Adw.StatusPage` shown (`system-search-symbolic` / `edit-paste-symbolic` icon, mode-specific title/description) |

### Interactions

| # | Action | Expected behavior |
|---|--------|-------------------|
| I1 | Type in entry | `updateSearch` runs on `notify::text` (mode switch, ranking as F3–F5) |
| I2 | Enter in apps mode | Window hides; first fuzzy match is launched |
| I3 | Escape in entry | Window hides |
| I4 | Click app button | Launch recorded in frecency, window hides, app launched via `uwsm-app -t service -- <entry>`; `application.frequency` incremented |
| I5 | Click clipboard item | `copyClipboardItem(item)` copies it; window hides |

### Edge cases

| # | Condition | Expected behavior |
|---|-----------|-------------------|
| E1 | App without desktop entry id | Frecency record skipped (`desktopId` undefined guard) |
| E2 | Clipboard item starting with `[` (binary/image marker) | Icon switches to `image-x-generic-symbolic` |
| E3 | No frecency data yet | "Most used apps"/"boosted by usage" hint label hidden |
| E4 | Re-render of app buttons | Child content created once per button (guards `gtk_button_set_child` assertion) |

## Visual (Adwaita alignment)

### Theme tokens

| Element | Token / style class | Notes |
|---------|--------------------|-------|
| Window | `card`, `frame`, `background` Adw classes | No custom background CSS |
| Body box | `applauncher-body` class, `spacing: 8` | |
| App name | `title-2`; description `body` | Adw typography |
| Hint labels / clipboard ID | `caption` | |
| App/clipboard button hover | `var(--shade-hover-bg, …)` / active `var(--shade-active-bg, …)` via `useStyle` | **Note**: these two tokens are not in `theme.ts` `CSS_VARS`; the rgba fallbacks are what the linter flags |
| Empty state | `Adw.StatusPage` | Symbolic icons only |
| App icon | 48px; clipboard icon 32px symbolic | |

### Adwaita checklist

- [ ] Colors only from Adw classes / `--shade-*` tokens — hover/active fallbacks must move to real theme tokens
- [ ] Spacing on the 6px grid (`spacing: 8/12`, `padding: 6px` are documented exceptions in `useStyle` blocks)
- [ ] Button radius via `--shade-radius` (currently hardcoded 8px in `useStyle`)
- [ ] Verified in light and dark variants
- [ ] Pointer cursor on clickable rows; focus lands in entry on open

## Test plan

- **Unit**: `updateSearch` mode/ranking logic (extract from `index.tsx` — it is
  pure given injected `getAppList`/`fuzzyQuery`/`searchClipboard`), frecency
  re-ranking, clipboard `>` prefix parsing.
- **Compliance linter**: current violations —
  `appButton.tsx:21,24` + `clipboardButton.tsx:17,20` `theme/hardcoded-color`
  (rgba fallbacks for the undefined `--shade-hover-bg`/`--shade-active-bg`
  tokens; fix by adding the tokens to `theme.ts`),
  `index.tsx:69` `reactivity/singleton-in-jsx`.
- **Visual/manual**: screenshots in light + dark of: most-used list, fuzzy
  results, clipboard mode, empty state.
